description: The factors and weights used to compute relevance score, which is then mapped to a tier. Factor weights are tunable via Tier 1 extension; the factor list itself is more stable.

computation.score_to_tier: score >= 0.75 → high; score >= 0.5 → medium; score >= 0.25 → low; score < 0.25 → none

case_observable_match.description: Number of case_observable watchlist entries this signal matches

thread_filter_match.description: Number of active monitoring thread filters this signal matches

watched_entity_overlap.description: Fraction of extracted entities that are on a watchlist

source_authority.description: Source reliability score (USGS official=1.0, mainstream news=0.7, blog=0.3, anonymous=0.1)

domain_match_user_interests.description: Whether signal domain (politics, defense, weather...) matches user's declared interest areas

recency.description: Decay function over time since event_time

event_time_precision.description: Bonus for high-precision event time (a signal with second-precision is more useful than year-precision)

pattern_membership.description: Bonus if signal contributes to a known pattern node (v2 — currently always 0)
pattern_membership._v1_status: Defined but always 0 in v1; pattern detection workers come in v2

content.tunable_doc: Factor weights are expected to be tuned over time as we learn what produces useful relevance scores. Tuning happens via Tier 1 extension (Gate A) — author a new version of this definition file, recompute the pack hash, bump active set. Historical scores remain queryable via LDU lineage.
